title: noli void rush controller
features:
how to use:
# be the killer in a round
# have noli equipped
# use void rush ability
- you will notice its way easier to turn

how to disable:
# execute the script again
script:
_G.VoidRushController = not _G.VoidRushController
local NoliConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Killers.Noli.Config)
if not _G.VoidRushVarsSetup then
    _G.VoidRushInitialTurnDur = NoliConfig.VoidRushInitialTurnDuration
    _G.VoidRushInitialTurnMult = NoliConfig.VoidRushInitialTurnMult
    _G.VoidRushVarsSetup = true
end

for _, v in getgc(true) do
    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnDuration") then
        if _G.VoidRushController then
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnDuration", 9999)
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnMult", 9999)
        else
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnDuration", _G.VoidRushInitialTurnDur)
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnMult", _G.VoidRushInitialTurnMult)
        end
    end
end

pcall(function()
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Void Rush Controller",
        Text = _G.VoidRushController and "Enabled\nRun the script again to disable" or "Disabled",
        Duration = 3
    })
end)
